summary: PlexdHook CRD controller implementation with Go types, KubeClient interface extensions, controller watch-create-status lifecycle, CRD YAML manifest, RBAC rules, and reference documentation. All tasks completed, all tests pass with race detector, go vet clean.

tests_checklist.item: Tests exist and pass (60+ tests, go test -race clean)
Edge cases covered (nil jobTemplate, already-processed, channel closed, ErrAlreadyExists)
Error paths tested (watch error, create job error, status update)
JSON round-trip tests for all types (PlexdHook, PlexdHookStatus, PlexdHookParam, PlexdHookEvent)
Field omission tests verify omitempty behavior
Security context tested for both privileged and non-privileged modes
Graceful shutdown and context cancellation tested

code_quality_checklist.item: Follows CRDController Start/Stop lifecycle pattern exactly
PlexdHook types follow PlexdNodeState struct/JSON tag pattern
mockPlexdHookClient extends mockKubeClient pattern from crdcontroller_test.go
CRD YAML follows plexdnodestate-crd.yaml structure (group, version, labels, printer columns)
No dead code, no TODOs, no stubs

security_checklist.item: Parameter names sanitized via regex before use as env var names
Non-privileged containers get readOnlyRootFilesystem=true and drop ALL capabilities
No sensitive data exposed in log messages
Owner references enable garbage collection (no orphaned Jobs)
RBAC follows least-privilege (plexdhooks get/list/watch only, no delete)

architecture_checklist.item: Solution follows existing controller pattern (no new abstractions)
Interface extension is backward-compatible (existing mocks updated)
RBAC changes are additive only (all existing rules preserved)
File locations match project structure conventions

dry_yagni_checklist.item: No duplicated code across controller implementations
Reuses existing KubeClient interface and sentinel errors

fail_fast_checklist.item: Watch error returned immediately from Start()
Job creation errors update status to Failed with error message
Status update failures logged as warnings (non-fatal, correct behavior)

defensive_checklist.item: Nil hook check in event processing (evt.Hook != nil)
Nil jobTemplate handled with busybox:latest default

suggested_improvements: D2 (minor): Consider extracting the default image 'busybox:latest' (plexdhook_controller.go:135) to a package-level constant for discoverability, though current inline usage is acceptable for a single reference
